6705: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides, palms down.
Lift your legs straight up over your hips.
Lower both legs to one side without touching the floor.
Bring them back up through the middle.
Lower to the other side and keep alternating.
6733: Set up under the shoulder pads with feet shoulder-width apart.
Unlock the machine and stand tall.
Push your hips back and lean your torso forward with a flat back.
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
Keep your knees slightly bent throughout.
6734: Sit in the angled sled and place one foot in the middle of the platform.
Release the safety and lower the sled by bending the knee.
Go as deep as you can with your back against the pad.
Press through your heel to straighten the leg without locking out.
Keep your hips flat on the seat.
Finish the reps and switch legs.
6735: Put a band around your thighs and rest your upper back on a bench.
Place a dumbbell across your hips and hold it steady.
Plant your feet and push your knees out against the band.
Drive your hips up until your torso is level.
Squeeze the glutes at the top.
6737: Put a band around your thighs or ankles and get into a side plank on your forearm.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Raise the top leg up against the band.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.
6738: Lie face down with your hips over a stability ball on a flat bench.
Loop a band around your feet and anchor it low in front.
Raise both legs until they are in line with your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
6739: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and put it on one ankle.
Kneel on all fours with the cuffed leg on the outside.
Keep your back flat and hips square.
Lift the knee out to the side against the cable.
Lower with control, then switch legs after your reps.
6741: Place a band around your thighs or ankles and kneel on a bench with hands on its edge.
Keep your back flat and hips level.
Lift one leg out behind you.
Sweep it in a half circle out to the side.
Return along the same path under control.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
6742: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and put it on one ankle.
Get on all fours facing the machine.
Keep your core braced and back flat.
Kick the leg back and slightly out on a diagonal.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return slowly, then switch legs after your reps.
6744: Put a band around your thighs or just above the knees.
Drop into a quarter squat with chest up.
Step sideways, keeping tension on the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting the feet touch.
Take several steps one way, then return the other way.
6745: Sit with your leg extended and a cable cuff on your foot.
Position the cable so it pulls the foot inward.
Turn the sole of your foot outward against the cable.
Finish the reps and switch feet.
6746: Sit with your leg extended and a cable cuff on your foot.
Position the cable so it pulls the foot outward.
Turn the sole of your foot inward against the cable.
Finish the reps and switch feet.
6747: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Press one foot back and up, leading with the heel.
Squeeze the glute at the top without arching your back.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
6748: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders.
Keep your back flat and core tight.
Bend one knee and curl your heel toward your glute.
Squeeze the hamstring at the top.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
6749: Sit tall on a bench or chair with feet flat.
Lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Keep your knee still and rotate the lower leg inward so the thigh turns outward.
Pause when you feel the hip working.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
6750: Stand tall on one leg with a soft knee, holding a wall if needed.
Lift the other knee to hip height.
Rotate the lifted knee out to the side, then back to the front.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
6751: Lie on your side with legs stacked and your bottom arm supporting your head.
Brace your core and keep your hips stacked.
Lift the top leg up and slightly back on a diagonal.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.
6752: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Place your hands lightly on your abs or behind your head.
Exhale and curl your shoulders off the floor.
Feel the abs tighten at the top.
6753: Lie on your back with your head resting on the floor.
Relax your shoulders away from your ears.
Gently tilt your head to one side without lifting your shoulder.
Feel a light engagement along the side of your neck.
6754: Lie on your side with your elbow bent 90 degrees and tucked at your waist.
Rest your forearm across your stomach.
Rotate your forearm upward, keeping the elbow in.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.
6755: Kneel side-on to a low cable and hold the handle with the far hand.
Tuck your elbow at your side, bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm outward, away from your belly.
Return slowly and switch arms after your reps.
6756: Kneel side-on to a low cable and hold the handle with the near hand.
Tuck your elbow at your side, bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm inward across your belly.
Return slowly and switch arms after your reps.
6757: Stand tall holding a dumbbell at your side, palm facing forward.
Keep your elbow tucked at your side.
Curl the weight up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until the arm is straight.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.
6758: Sit by a bench and rest your forearm on it with your hand past the edge.
Hold a dumbbell with a hammer grip.
Rotate your palm up as far as you can.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.
6759: Sit tall with your heels on the floor.
Lift the toes of one foot as high as you can.
Press them up against light resistance such as the other foot.
Finish the reps, then switch feet.
6760: Set a cable at chest height and kneel sideways to it.
Hold the handle with both hands in front of your chest.
Brace your abs and keep your hips square.
Rotate your torso away from the machine.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.
6761: Start on all fours and bring one knee forward behind your wrist.
Slide the other leg straight back.
Square your hips to the floor.
Fold forward gently over the front leg.
6762: Stand with feet wider than your hips.
Reach one arm overhead and toward the opposite foot.
Bend diagonally, keeping your hips facing forward.
Reach only as far as is comfortable.
Return to standing and switch sides.
6763: Sit tall and extend one arm in front of you, palm up.
With the other hand, gently pull the fingers back toward you.
Keep the elbow straight and shoulders relaxed.
Turn the palm down to stretch the other side, then switch arms.
6764: Hinge forward at the hips with soft knees.
Let your arms and head hang down.
6765: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Place one hand on the side of your head.
Gently tilt your head toward the shoulder, using light pressure.
6766: Lie on your side with a small ball under the inside of your lower leg.
Support yourself with your hands and the other leg.
Slowly roll the leg along the ball from calf toward ankle.
Pause on tender spots with light pressure.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch legs.
6767: Lie on your side with a small ball under the side of your neck.
Support your head with a pillow or your hand.
Gently press or nod to roll over the ball.
6768: Lie on your side with a small ball under the side of your neck.
Support your head so your neck stays neutral.
Gently move your head to roll over the ball.
6769: Lie on your back with knees bent and a small ball under the base of your skull.
Relax your head onto the ball.
Make small nods or turns to roll over the muscle.
6770: Kneel on one knee in a half-kneeling position.
Tuck your pelvis and squeeze the glute of the back leg.
Lean slightly to the side of the back leg.
6771: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
Tuck your pelvis and brace your abs.
Shift your weight forward until you feel the stretch at the front of the hip.
Raise the arm on the kneeling side overhead.
6772: Stand near a wall for balance.
Cross one foot behind and turn the sole so the outer edge presses into the floor.
Gently shift your weight onto that foot.
Feel the stretch along the outside of the lower leg.
6773: Stand near a wall for balance.
Place the top of one foot on the floor behind you with toes curled under.
Gently bend the standing knee to press forward.
Feel the stretch along the shin.
6774: Sit tall and clasp your hands in front of your chest.
Push your arms forward and round your upper back.
Tuck your chin slightly and spread the shoulder blades apart.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
6775: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Spread your toes wide and press all of them into the floor.
Lift your toes while keeping the ball of the foot down.
6776: Set a cable at chest height and grab the handle with one hand.
Stand with feet staggered and your torso slightly braced.
Pull the handle toward you with your elbow flared out.
Squeeze the rear shoulder at the end.
Extend slowly, then switch arms after your reps.
6785: Sit tall on a bench with a band around your thighs above the knees.
Keep your feet flat and planted.
Press your knees apart against the band.
Hold for a second at the widest point.
Bring the knees back together slowly.
6786: Lie on your back with legs straight.
Place one foot on the opposite knee.
Let the bent knee drop out to the side.
Relax and notice how far it goes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without forcing it.
6787: Sit or lie with the knee bent 90 degrees.
Swing the lower leg inward so the hip rotates outward.
Stop where you feel a stretch or end of range.
Note how far each side goes.
6788: Sit or lie with the knee bent 90 degrees.
Swing the lower leg outward so the hip rotates inward.
Stop where you feel a stretch or end of range.
Note how far each side goes.
6789: Lie flat on your back with legs straight and feet together.
Compare the position of your heels or ankles.
Bend your knees and lift your hips, then lower and straighten again.
6790: Stand or lie with your elbow bent 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Keep your elbow against your body.
Stop where you feel a stretch or end of range.
Note how far each side goes.
6791: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Reach one arm behind your back with the palm facing out.
Slide your hand slowly up your spine as far as is comfortable.
Note how high your thumb reaches, keeping your chest open.
Lower the arm, then repeat with the other side to compare.
6792: Stand relaxed with your feet hip-width apart and arms hanging loose.
Look straight ahead and let your shoulders settle naturally.
Check in a mirror, or ask a friend, whether both shoulders are at the same height.
Roll the shoulders once and re-check without shrugging.
Note any difference and repeat now and then to track it.
6793: Stand with your feet together and your knees straight.
Hinge at the hips and slowly reach down toward your toes.
Let your head and arms hang relaxed without bouncing.
Note how far your fingertips reach.
Rise slowly, rolling up one vertebra at a time.
6794: Sit at the end of a bench, then lie back and hug one knee to your chest.
Let the other leg hang off the edge with the thigh relaxed.
Keep your lower back flat on the bench.
Notice whether the hanging thigh rises above the bench or the knee straightens.
6795: Sit at the end of a bench and lie back, pulling one knee to your chest.
Let the other leg hang down off the edge, fully relaxed.
Keep your lower back pressed down and your pelvis still.
Watch whether the hanging leg drifts outward or the thigh lifts.
6796: Place a chair behind you and set the bar on your upper back.
Take a wide stance with toes turned out.
Sit back and down until you lightly touch the chair.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand up.
6797: Place the bar on your upper back and stand beside a bench.
Put the inside foot flat on the bench.
Press through that heel and stand up on the bench.
Lower the other foot back down under control.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.
6798: Loop the band around your ankles or hold it under your standing foot.
Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee and brace your abs.
Kick the other leg straight back against the band.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your lower back.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
6799: Lie on your back holding a dumbbell with both hands overhead.
Lift your legs and torso together, angling toward one side.
Reach the dumbbell toward your feet.
